Had an interesting time hunting for the late bloomers. Very very dusty though especially it was dry and windy.

Plum flowers are mostly gone as of 3/11/25, there are 2 trees in good bloom and 1 of them still blooming out of 40-50 trees there. I'm sure it would be super pretty if I got here 2 weeks earlier, but since the flowers are gone, there is no crowd. At least I got to see the tree in bloom by myself. The birds are also making sure to take down what's left of the flowers 😂

758.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、具材がたっぷりで食べ応えのあるベーグルや、おいしいコーヒー、焼き菓子が高く評価されています。ベーグルは様々な種類があり、ハーフサイズも選べるため、少食の人でも食べやすいという声があります。また、店内は落ち着いた雰囲気で、居心地が良いという感想が多くあります。スタッフも親しみやすく、丁寧な対応が好評のようです。価格も手頃で、コストパフォーマンスが良いという意見もあります。

rv.t: A rare find that we ended up visiting three times during our stay in East Tokyo. It’s a true hidden gem with a heartwarming atmosphere and delicious bagels that made for the perfect breakfast. So, give it a try!

This place is truly hidden away so don’t walk past it when your map gets confused. But inside it’s got cozy jazz playing with a few small tables and leather seats. I had the lox bagel, which was delicious. The bagel is fluffy and the lox is perfect. The ice cream coffee float was also really good. Glad I visited this spot!

Perfect find after Sumo morning. Owner also sumo fan. Very nice hidden in alcove place, like a secret spot or nook. Inside is like a nice place read a bit. Brilliant black coffee house blend. Smooth. My wife had a latte which she said was just right with not too much milk. Home made matcha cookie and crumb cake were just right. Wanted a bagel sandwich but had a bid breakfast and saving room for Sumo soup at lunch…

It was fantastic and delicious and a must try. It’s an open…

760.a: Sugahara Kogei Glass, 797 Fujishita, Kujukuri, Sambu District, Chiba 283-0112, Japan
760.aj: 〒283-0112 千葉県山武郡九十九里町藤下７９７ 菅原工芸硝子

rv.t: 素晴らしい体験でした。 入店するとズラリと広がる煌びやかなガラス達…… それら一つ一つに職人の魂、炎の熱が与えられたものだと肌で感じられます。個人的にもはやパワースポット。 また、店員さんの感じも非常に良く、うわべだけではない善良さを感じました。 もちろん、肝心の商品の方も、どれもこれも見惚れてしまう美しさ。こんなにガラスで魅了されるものなのかと驚きました。故に、価格はお高めですが納得がいきます。 私は一つ、アイスコーヒーを飲む用にグラスを購入させていただきました。手に持つと心地よい重みがあり、口当たりは良く、冗談抜きでいつもよりコーヒーが美味しくなってました。もう洗う際は宝物みたいに扱ってます（笑） 店内はゆとりのある空間だったので、周りやすかったです。なかなか変わった物もあり面白かったですよ！ 必ずまた行きます！

rv.a: Dandylion BAR (ダンディライオン バー)
rv.t: 千葉県、というより関東近辺では有名なクラフトガラスの工場と直売所です。 千葉県のバーテンダー御用達ですね。 若い職人さんも多く在籍し新しいデザインも随時出てきます。 都内のショップより在庫は多いです。 （工場なので当たり前かな） 工場見学、製作体験もありますね。 予約制なのでウェブ参照との事です。 敷地内にカフェも併設されています。 桜のシーズンはお花見しながら珈琲が飲めますよ。 敷地入り口が自動車教習所と同じところで、初めて行くと「ここで良いのかな？」って思いますがご心配なく。 会員登録すると割り引きあります。

ガラス体験を彼女としてみたく訪問。 土曜日の朝10時からの予約で、その後も訪問者が絶えなかったので人気の体験なのだと思います。 体験内容は画像a-oの中からひとつを選択してそれに似た形を作成するもの。 職員さん及び職人さんから説明があるので不器用な方でも問題なくできると思います。 職人さんが運んでくれるガラスの量が一定であり基本形も決まっているため、自分の形は出せないのが歯がゆいところでした。1時間の枠に対して、自分がガラスに触れている時間はリアルに60秒ほどなので物足りなかったというのが正直なところでした。(1400℃のガラスを長時間ビギナーに扱わせたら怪我する恐れが高いのでしょうがないとは思いますが) ショップ内には様々な作品(商品)が展示されており、どれも素晴らしいものでした。個人的にはダービーというグラスが欲しかったのですが、その日の競馬で大勝ちできなかったので諦めました。

rv.t: Cebu Ocean Park is the biggest oceanarium in the Philippines and it’s a solid half-day activity, especially with kids or if you need AC. The exhibits are well maintained and the layout flows nicely so you don’t feel crammed even on weekends. Highlights: • Jungle Trek and Deep Tank Lagoon are the stars. The 360° tunnel with stingrays and sharks swimming overhead is worth the ticket alone • Bird Show and Sea Lion Show…

Cheaper to buy tickets via Klook especially if you plan to bundle with another active like Stingray feeding and snorkeling. I forgot to buy a day in advance though so had to swallow the entrance door price. It came with free photo taking for 3 pictures so I guess I feel a bit better about it. Their ocean park has a bit of a zoo in it - kind of like Philippine Biodome but smaller scale so to be fair - the Philippine…

Had a great experience at Cebu Ocean Park! The highlight for me was the fish feeding activity, especially seeing the lemon shark interact with the scuba diver—it was such a fun and memorable moment! The Oceanarium was also enjoyable and there were lots of marine animals to see. The staff were friendly and the place was a nice way to spend a few hours. Even as a solo visitor, you can still enjoy the experience as…

rv.t: Unforgettable day use experience. Beautiful beach, spacious infinity pool, sumptuous food, and very refreshing drinks. Reserve your day use slot because they only let in a limited number of day use guests in a day, especially if they have multiple guests who booked rooms. The staff always went beyond to give us the best service. Love that.

I had such a great time at Cebu Beach Club in Argao. The moment we arrived, the staff welcomed us so warmly that it instantly felt like a good start to the trip. Everyone was super friendly and helpful the whole time — you can really feel that they enjoy taking care of their guests. The infinity pool is honestly one of my favorite parts. The view from there is amazing — you get this wide, relaxing view of the beach…

The atmosphere was lovely, relaxing, and very inviting. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and well-trained. The food was wonderful, offering a wide variety of choices, all prepared with great care and precision. The rooms were well-maintained, comfortable, and provided a perfect respite after a day of adventure.||The main highlight was the overall environment —the view was breathtaking, with a beautiful orange…

rv.t: Pretty standard steakhouse with historical vibes and classic flavors. 🍞🥖🧈Complimentary bread is definitely my VIP. Clear beef soup was straightforward beef broth and veggie soup. Clam chowder soup was surprisingly “red”, not the creamy white soup. They said “Here in Manhattan, it’s red not white” which was kinda interesting. The flavor was also straightforward, you taste what you see in the bowl. Salmon was normal…

When in New York City, you’d be missing out on one of the best dining experiences if you don’t visit Gallagher’s. Our group dined in before seeing a show and it was excellent from start to finish. Our servers, Robert and Sal, were incredible. The entirety of our stay was filled with delicious food, tasty drinks and personable interactions with each staff member. The atmosphere was classic and invigorating. The…

We came here for a special anniversary dinner, and Gallagher's absolutely lived up to the hype. The atmosphere is classic, old-school New York steakhouse perfection, from the meat lockers out front to the rolling carts in the dining room. The food was incredible from start to finish. We started raw with the steak tartare and steak carpaccio, both perfectly executed, along with a half-dozen oysters (the Rhode Island…

765.a: Japan, 〒904-2141 Okinawa, Ikehara, 2 Chome−11−7 Evertrail Okinawa Camping Car Rental

765.ed: People say this camper rental service offers well-equipped vehicles with everything needed for camping, including comfortable sleeping arrangements and cooking supplies. They also highlight the exceptional customer service, with staff providing helpful recommendations and assistance with campsite bookings. Guests mention the convenience of exploring Okinawa's natural beauty and diverse camping…
765.edj: このキャンピングカーレンタルサービスを利用した人は、快適な寝床や調理器具など、キャンプに必要なものがすべて揃った設備が充実していると評価しています。また、スタッフが役立つアドバイスやキャンプ場の予約手配をしてくれるなど、顧客サービスが素晴らしいという声が多くあります。利用者は、これらの車両で沖縄の豊かな自然や多様なキャンプスポットを気軽に巡れる点も気に入っているようです。

rv.t: My wife and I recently rented the Nissan Caravan from Evertrail for a three-night trip across Okinawa, and the experience completely exceeded our expectations. As one of the largest vehicles in their fleet, it provided the ultimate luxury camping experience. Being 6ft (184cm) tall, I am often wary of camper van beds, but I was able to sleep incredibly comfortably in the back with plenty of room to spare. The…

I booked this trip mainly because I followed Evertrail on Instagram and was completely captivated by the adventures they showcased. The entire booking process was seamless, and we received a comprehensive guide right after booking. The campsites were easy to locate using the guide, and the Evertrail team was incredibly efficient in securing the campsites we wanted each day as we drove from one place to another…

We rented the Hijet from Evertrail and it honestly made our whole trip! If you're a first-timer like us and not sure what camper van life involves, don't worry — Evertrail has thought of everything so we just showed up and go. There's something special about a campervan holiday. It's really the way to go if you want to enjoy the slower pace of life — falling asleep under a sky full of stars and waking up to the…

766.ed: Diners like this restaurant's wide variety of delicious tofu dishes, including hearty set meals with numerous small side dishes, and highlight the complimentary, unlimited soy milk, miki, and hot tofu. They also mention the generous portions offer excellent value, and the staff are friendly and provide fast service.
766.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、ボリューム満点の定食や多くの小鉢料理など、種類豊富な豆腐料理を高く評価しています。濃厚な豆乳や風味豊かな湯豆腐、奄美の伝統的な発酵飲料であるミキがセルフサービスで楽しめる点も特徴です。また、スタッフは親切で丁寧な対応をしてくれるという声や、料理の提供が早いというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Excellent lunch options with plenty of small side dishes. Each are prepared and are fresh with the taste of local produce. Highlights were: - Yuba Harumaki - Tofu Hamburger - daily special. - Miki drink. The staff were friendly , and food was served quickly.

The shop opens at 10am, and the restaurant opens at 11am. You can start putting your name on a waiting list at 10:45am. It is quite busy, so expect a wait time. The food was delicious. We had the hamburg steak set and the salted pork set. Set menus and light meals came with unlimited soy milk and tofu. Would come back again.

The tofu harumaki set was delicious! Service was super fast and the staff was very kind as well. Although the closing time on Maps is stated as 17:00/18:00, they will often close much earlier than that. At first we tried to get late lunch at 15:00, but they had already closed for the day, so the next day we came at 13:30. The decor is quite dated but at the same time also has a homey feel. The English menu has a lot…

767.a: Japan, 〒894-0513 Kagoshima, Amami, Kasaricho Oaza Sotoganeku, 1014-2 AMAMI Retreat salon amaja herb
767.aj: 〒894-0513 鹿児島県奄美市笠利町大字外金久１０１４−２ AMAMI Retreat salon amaja herb

rv.t: ハーブ園でワークショップができる！楽しい！ なんども来たくなるハーブ園です。 季節毎に生えてる植物が変わるので何度来ても飽きないと思います。 ワークショップでは、今まで雑草だと思ってた草がスーパーハーブだったり、効能や使い方をわかりやすく面白く教えてくれます。その場に生えてる葉っぱを食べてみたり、私の体調に合わせたハーブ茶を煎じてくれます。これがまた美味しい！いい香り！
軟膏作り体験しました。ハーブは自家栽培のものをオーナーさんと一緒に収穫。オーナーさんがハーブのことや、歴史をわかりやすく教えてくれました。ハーブをもっと生活に取り入れようという気になりました。 目的に合ったものを軟膏を好きなアロマと組み合わせて作れて本当にいい体験でした。また来ます。

奄美に友達を呼んで3人でここに行ったのですが、始まってすぐ外出て3秒ぐらいの場所にスーパーハーブがあると教えてくださりコレが?!っと驚きの連続でした 元からハーブ好きな友達も色々知れてすごく喜んでました! 体験したのは石鹸作りと軟膏作りだったのですがとってきたハーブを煮ている間いい香りがずっと続いて常にリラックスできました 常に笑顔で楽しく教えてくださり 本当に良い1日を過ごせました めっちゃ楽しかったですハーブに少しでも興味があればぜひ体験して欲しいです

768.a: Japan, 〒894-0411 Kagoshima, Oshima District, Tatsugo, Akaogi, 1330ｰ1 宿うふた 内 ブランチfanfan

Guests mention the reasonable prices for the volume of food and appreciate the presence of a cute resident cat.
768.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、美味しくてボリュームのある料理を高く評価しています。特にスペアリブ、黒糖唐揚げ、風味豊かな麻婆豆腐が人気です。また、居心地の良いリラックスした雰囲気や、親しみやすく親切なスタッフが地元の役立つ情報を教えてくれる点も好評です。料理の量に対して価格が手頃であるという声や、かわいい看板猫がいることに喜びを感じる人もいます。

rv.t: Unmissable, the food here is simply divine. When we went the owner shared with us his recommendation, salad to start with prosciutto and carrot sauce dressing, followed by sashimi, teriyaki fried chicken and root veg with whole stewed fish to finish. It's a nice place with a great view serving good locally sourced food, good music and good conversation. I recommend it

We had dinner at fanfan on our last evening on Amami island and it was the best meal of our trip. What a treasure! The food was exceptional, with carefully prepared fantastic local ingredients. We chose the Omakase (chef's choice meal) and it consisted of many courses for a fantastic price. The atmosphere of the restaurant in February was quiet, but I believe the vibe would be so fun in warmer weather with outdoor…
Very cute place the vibe is chill, food is delicious . I have several annoying dietary restrictions and the owner/chef was happy to accommodate all of them, making for a very happy birthday dinner .

771.a: Amami City Amami Museum, 517 Nazenagahamacho, Amami, Kagoshima 894-0036, Japan
771.aj: 〒894-0036 鹿児島県奄美市名瀬長浜町５１７ 奄美市立奄美博物館
771.edj: 独特の文化を形成してきた奄美の歴史や暮らし、自然に関する展示や講演会を行う博物館。伝統的な小型舟や農具、生物の標本など展示する。

rv.t: A very interesting museum about the local area and the Amami islands history. There are three levels, sea travel, farming techniques and nature and seasonal changes on the island. Very informative.

Highly recommended to learn about history, people, and nature of the island. First floor has good video programs; select English subtitles, then the video you wish to see. A detailed relief model of the island on the first floor is great for planning. First floor exhibits focus on life by the sea, second floor is about history and culture, third floor focuses on nature. Most labels are only in Japanese, so Google…

Small museum but the exhibits are nice. There is English signage that cover the basics. They have a couple of interactive displays too which is fun. Be sure to explore the traditional house on the other side of the lawn. It's worth a look. (Technically you can look at this for free without visiting the museum.)

772.a: Kamepan Cafe, 3 Chome-38-9 Mukojima, Sumida City, Tokyo 131-0033, Japan

They also highlight the extensive drink bar options and the ability to warm bread using in-store toasters. Other reviews mention the service can be inefficient.

rv.t: Super good and friendly. Speak English and have English menus. Highly recommend. If you can try their bakery across the street, do it! It was really really good.
Had a dinner party table of 6. The bread and salad buffet was reasonable and tasty. The meals were almost good enough. Good cost performance 😃

明太マドンナを食べたくて遥々神奈川から押上に❇️月曜日のお昼、二人だったので事前予約をしました。(11時半か12時オンリー) 予約無しなら列が違いますが席が空き次第、案内してくれます。 明太マドンナは滴り落ちるパン❕といった感じで大きさ、味、共に満足出来ました。 これはハマルね☺️ 相方とシェアしたかったのでもう１つはカレーハンバーグに。個人的にはつなぎが多い既製ハンバーグにカレーをかけた感じがしました。こちらはぶっちゃけいまいち。 【良い点】 ●ランチメニューが何個かある。 ●物によってはお手頃価格。 ●サラダとパン食べ放題は嬉しい。 ●時間無制限。 ●ドリンクバーの種類が豊富。 マシーンの物が特に美味しかった。 【悪い点】 ●タイミングにより結構並ぶ。 ●パンをトースト出来るが導線が悪い。 グループで一気にトーストするべき。 ●席が狭すぎる&隣とのスペースも狭い。 ●窓のブラインドが埃だらけ。 ●バターが別料金 【結論】…

772.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

773.a: Big II Amami, 580 Nakagachi, Tatsugo, Oshima District, Kagoshima 894-0106, Japan
773.aj: 〒894-0106 鹿児島県大島郡龍郷町中勝５８０ ビッグツー奄美店

rv.t: This store is legendary. It has everything. My family went and we all said that we could get lost in the store for hours. It has everything from fishing supplies to groceries. One of my favorite sections in the store was the local products. They had a wide selection of Amami-made goods. If you are looking for something specific in Amami, then the chances are that you’ll find it here.
The store has all sorts of local food and beverages
If you come to Amami Island of Japan and looking for the goods that are genuine and indigenous to this island. This Big 2 offers the wide selection of it!

773.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

774.a: THE HIRAMATSU HOTELS & RESORTS SENGOKUHARA, 1245-337 Sengokuhara, Hakone, Ashigarashimo District, Kanagawa 250-0631, Japan
774.aj: 〒250-0631 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町仙石原１２４５−３３７ THE HIRAMATSU HOTELS & RESORTS 仙石原
774.ed: Upscale hotel offering choice rooms with hot-spring baths, plus complimentary breakfast & dinner.
774.edj: 全客室に源泉掛け流しの温泉風呂を備えた、ハイエンドなリゾートホテル。コース料理を提供するレストランあり。

rv.t: Staying at the Hiramatsu was the highlight of our trip. One of very few places that I genuinely miss after leaving. The room is clean, spacious, and relaxing. The food is phenomenal; I still think about the bread. The location is actually quite convenient, a very short walk to a bus stop that can take you everywhere around Hakone. Most of all, the staff is *amazing*, especially our primary host, Dennis. He was so…

Beautiful hotel! Mr Dennis Cheong provided great service. He is multi lingual and everything he arranged was top notch, from the food preference to the arrangements for breakfast, dinner and the private bath. The level of service here is what really makes the difference. It combines the warm hospitality of other east Asian countries with the precision typical of Japan. We had the room in the main building and it was…

This was my absolute favorite experience during a visit to Japan. The service team is incredible and treated every guest with care. So many things make this an unforgettable stay -- the staff, the rooms, the food, the surrounding area. If you like museums, Hakone is worth it just to see The POLA (although be prepared to take local buses). I highly recommend staying here!

775.a: Lake Wenatchee State Park, 21588 SR 207, Leavenworth, WA 98826
775.aj: レイク・ワナッチー州立公園 21588 SR 207, Leavenworth, WA 98826 アメリカ合衆国
775.ed: Lake & river confluence with camping, hiking, horseback riding & water sports in forested surrounds.

rv.t: We have camped here for the past 2 years and always have such a blast. There is a cute little camp store on the beach that has EVERYTHING you can think of, from air mattresses, water toys and cubes, camping necessities and even hot and cold food. They serve real ice cream cones and even coffee.

Great place for paddle boarding. We visited at the South Entrance. The lake is beautiful and the walk to the water easy. Swimming area is roped off. Lots of picnic tables and shade. Parking filled up quickly after 12 noon. Bathrooms clean.

Beautiful Lakeside park. It was clean and very accessible. They even have a path across the sand that would allow wheelchairs to get close to the bank. It was very windy when we went in June, but that didn't stop people from swimming! They have a small shop and looked like they rent various watercraft like floaties, kayaks, and tubes too. We will absolutely go back again when it's warmer.

776.a: Bellevue Botanical Garden, 12001 Main St, Bellevue, WA 98005
776.aj: ベルビュー・ボタニカル・ガーデン 12001 Main St, Bellevue, WA 98005 アメリカ合衆国
776.ed: Gardens, woodlands & wetlands along with holiday light festivities, art exhibits & concerts.
776.edj: 庭園、森林、湿地帯があり、休日にはライトアップ イベントが開かれる。美術展やコンサートも開催される。

rv.t: such a beautiful and peaceful place to visit. The gardens are well maintained, with colorful flowers, amazing plants, and beautiful walking paths. It’s a perfect spot for a relaxing walk, taking photos, or spending quality time with family and friends. Every season brings something new to see, and the atmosphere feels calm and refreshing. A must-visit place in Bellevue! A definitely yes!! Place for Nature ❤️ lover…

A beautiful green space in the heart of the city. Plenty of walking trails, beautiful flowers & greenery with many benches to sit and take in nature's beauty. The hydrangeas are absolutely gorgeous. The ravine experience with the suspension bridge is nice, especially for kids. The Japanese Garden (Yao Garden) has wonderful colors especially in the fall. The rock garden is full of bloom during late spring / summer…

Excellent place to visit in Bellevue. The garden has a wonderful collection of different themed landscapes including native Northwest plant gardens, perennial flower gardens, woodland trails, wetlands, and beautifully maintained seasonal displays. The landscaping, walking paths, and overall environmental maintenance are excellent. A peaceful and refreshing place for relaxation, photography, and enjoying nature…

777.a: Costco Wholesale, 7725 188th Ave NE, Redmond, WA 98052
777.aj: Costco Wholesale, 7725 188th Ave NE, Redmond, WA 98052 アメリカ合衆国
777.ed: Members-only warehouse selling a huge variety of items including bulk groceries, electronics & more.
777.edj: 食料雑貨や電化製品など、幅広い品目をまとめ売りする会員制倉庫型店。

rv.t: This Costco is nice and clean well stocked with all the latest merchandise and bulk foods.

I love this Costco location! The parking lot tends to feel a lot calmer than other locations, at least in my experience, but honestly it really depends on the day and time you go. Be prepared for either a full on battlefield or a smooth, peaceful shopping trip... there's really no in between! 🤣 Overall, we love Costco. The deals and prices are amazing, and we've been happy members for the past two years. As someone…
wanted to give a huge shoutout to the cashier Dalia at Costco today! She was so kind, efficient, and made my shopping experience really smooth. Great customer service—thank you so much!”

778.a: Downtown Park, 16101 Redmond Wy, Redmond, WA 98052
778.aj: ダウンタウン・パーク 16101 Redmond Wy, Redmond, WA 98052 アメリカ合衆国
778.ed: Visitors say this park offers a clean and neat environment, with open spaces perfect for relaxing and enjoying the sun. They also highlight the family-friendly atmosphere, mentioning it's a great spot for walks and for children to play in sprinklers. Others also say the park hosts various events, providing different experiences from regular parks.

rv.t: I haven’t been to Redmond for a long time and I was very pleasantly surprised to see a beautiful park built among modern apartments. The park is quite large and has a lawn for children with many sitting area around. There is also public restroom with showers outside.
Christmas lights on! A night walk with family even in rain felt warm. This bring home feel for locals.
We enjoy going there and having an ice cream at Molly Moon and letting the kids run through the sprinklers. It’s a great place to have peace playing in the water and eat Molly Moon ice cream.

779.a: The Screaming Parrots Cafe: Desserts + Tea + Bites, 16095 Cleveland St ste 110, Redmond, WA 98052
779.aj: The Screaming Parrots Cafe: Desserts + Tea + Bites, 16095 Cleveland St ste 110, Redmond, WA 98052 アメリカ合衆国
catj: ブランチ レストラン
コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
デザート ショップ
779.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious soufflé pancakes, crepes, and high-quality matcha and tea lattes. They also highlight the cozy, welcoming atmosphere, and the friendly, attentive staff. Visitors appreciate the late operating hours and convenient parking with validation.

rv.t: Screaming Parrots Cafe is a vibrant spot with a menu that definitely hits the spot if you’re looking for something indulgent! We tried two of the soufflé pancakes, and while they were incredibly delicious and light in texture, they are very rich. We found that "less is more" with these—they are definitely large enough to share, especially if you’re eyeing other menu items. The Nutella crepe was a standout and…

I decided to give The Screaming Parrots a try and I’m so glad I did! Everything on the menu looked so appetizing that it was hard to choose. I ordered a Dancong oolong latte, a salmon crepe, and a basque mango cheesecake. The drink menu is impressive, they have real tea options like Pu Er, Dancong, osmanthus and Da Pai Hong, not just the usual milk teas. My oolong latte was fragrant and smooth, and the tea flavor…

Screaming parrots is a speciality cafe located in Redmond in a quieter street. I was drawn to new local cafe spots and drawn to the clean interiors and stylish menu options. They are open quite late (11pm) and I appreciate that their online ordering system works! They are a very hygenic and trendy cafe with good quality drinks. I ordered the screaming parrots latte, mango matcha latte and matcha basque cheesecake…
